description: The other Christian Hole — KD96-WX7, the Otter Tail County man the 1885 state census actually belongs to. Added after a scratch run scored Tool Arguments 2: having called source_attachments and been told HOLE-003 is also attached to KD96-WX7, the skill read that person to find out who they are, and no fixture covered it, so the call returned fixture_not_found. The call is sound — the body's step 4(b) asks the report to say where a misattributed record does belong, and naming a bare PID does not do that. His facts line up with the 1885 record and against KD96-TV2's: born 1852 rather than 1875, Otter Tail rather than Polk. No sourceDescriptions in the predicate, so this matches whether or not the skill asks for them.
